protocol: char_wb TF-IDF cosine; vocabulary fit on train endpoints; threshold selected on dev; task-cluster bootstrap on test; no test selection
interpretation: Pair verification only; not K-way family attribution.
Google and Mistral two-generator folds are diagnostic-only because holding out one generator leaves no same-family positive in train/dev.
Aggregate is an unweighted descriptive mean over admitted folds, not a pooled test estimate.
